title: Drupal Migration
meta: Move content to Drupal from WordPress or another platform, or upgrade an older Drupal site, with redirects. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Migrate to Drupal or upgrade to the current version
overview: We bring your content into Drupal from WordPress, another CMS or an older Drupal site. After we map your content types, authors, categories and media, we run a test migration and show you samples before the full run. Old page addresses are redirected so visitors and search engines keep landing on the right page. If you are upgrading, we move you to the current supported version.

Older Drupal to current version path

faq: Which platforms can you migrate from?
WordPress, Joomla, Drupal 7 and later versions, Squarespace, Wix and custom systems with an export are all common. Send us the current address and we confirm how to pull the content.
We keep page titles, descriptions and addresses where possible, and redirect any that change. No migration can promise unchanged rankings, but we build it to protect them.
Yes. Because Drupal 7 to the current release is a rebuild rather than a click, the Premium package covers a mid sized site. Very large or heavily custom sites may need a separate quote.
Does my old site stay online?
Yes. We work from a copy and only change your live site when you choose a launch day. We can help on that day with the cutover.
